description: Utility functions for URL handling in the Mattermost web application, including URL validation, formatting, and extraction.

methods.name: cleanUpUrlable
methods.description: Sanitizes and normalizes a string to be URL-friendly.

methods.name: getShortenedURL
methods.description: Returns a shortened version of a URL, adding ellipsis if it exceeds a certain length.

methods.name: getSiteURLFromWindowObject
methods.description: Constructs the site URL from a WindowObject.

methods.name: getSiteURL
methods.description: Retrieves the site URL, either via module or from window object.

methods.name: getBasePathFromWindowObject
methods.description: Gets the base path from a WindowObject.

methods.name: getBasePath
methods.description: Gets the base path from the window object.

methods.name: getRelativeChannelURL
methods.description: Constructs a relative URL for a channel given team and channel names.

methods.name: isUrlSafe
methods.description: Checks if a URL is safe to use (prevents javascript:, vbscript:, data:).

methods.name: makeUrlSafe
methods.description: Returns the URL if safe, otherwise a default URL.

methods.name: getScheme
methods.description: Extracts the scheme (protocol) from a URL.

methods.name: removeScheme
methods.description: Removes the scheme from a URL.

methods.name: formattedError
methods.description: Formats an error message, optionally using internationalization.

methods.name: validateChannelUrl
methods.description: Validates a channel URL against naming rules and returns errors if invalid.

methods.name: mightTriggerExternalRequest
methods.description: Determines if a URL might trigger an external request based on its pattern.

methods.name: isInternalURL
methods.description: Checks if a URL is internal to the site.

methods.name: shouldOpenInNewTab
methods.description: Decides if a URL should open in a new tab based on its path.

methods.name: isPermalinkURL
methods.description: Checks if a URL is a permalink URL.

methods.name: isValidUrl
methods.description: Checks if a URL is valid (starts with http or https).

methods.name: isStringContainingUrl
methods.description: Checks if a string contains a URL.

methods.name: teamNameToUrl
methods.description: Converts a team name to a URL-safe string, with validation.

methods.name: channelNameToUrl
methods.description: Converts a channel name to a URL-safe string, with validation.

methods.name: parseLink
methods.description: Parses a link, prepending protocol if missing, and checks safety.

methods.name: validHttpUrl
methods.description: Validates and constructs a URL object from a string.
